page: Microsoft Azure F2amds_v7 is a memory-intensive virtual machine belonging to the Famdsv7 server family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, offering 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores at a high clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The CPU features a 32 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and cryptography acceleration. The hardware profile is characterized by a high memory-to-CPU ratio, providing 16.0 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per core) alongside 236 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capabilities.

Benchmark data highlights exceptional single-core capabilities, with both stress-ng and Geekbench single-core metrics placing the server in the top 10% tier. Single-threaded operations, such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, also achieve top-tier performance. However, the dual-core configuration presents a clear tradeoff in parallel processing; multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation with Clang fall into the weaker performance brackets. Memory bandwidth and database operations perform consistently within the average range.

This server type provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that demand high memory density and strong single-thread performance without requiring massive parallelization. It is highly suited for memory-bound applications, text processing, lightweight database operations, and single-threaded data manipulation tasks that benefit from dedicated local storage.
